request.text: Can you find the new 13-inch MacBook Air with the M1 chip and 32 GB of built-in memory for delivery to Beirut?

message:
Apple never made a 13-inch M1 MacBook Air with 32GB memory: it supports only 8GB or 16GB, and the memory cannot be upgraded.
Closest checked alternatives, both listed in stock:
• Classic Phones: 13-inch M1 Air, 8GB/256GB, Space Grey — $650.00; explicitly listed as new.
• Classic Phones: 13.6-inch M4 Air, 24GB/512GB — $1275.00; not 32GB, and new condition is unconfirmed. Its description also mixes M4 and M2 details, so verify the specification before buying.
The shop advertises delivery throughout Lebanon, including Beirut; shipping is calculated at checkout, with no confirmed fee.
If 32GB is essential, choose a newer Air configuration rather than an M1; I did not find a verified 32GB offer in the checked listings.

Launched in early 2024, this 13.6-inch model, presented in a sophisticated Space Gray finish, is designed for users who prioritize portability without compromising on speed or capability.
At the heart of the MXCR3LL/A is the groundbreaking Apple M3 chip. This advanced System on a Chip (SoC) integrates an 8-core CPU, featuring 4 high-performance cores and 4 high-efficiency cores. This architecture ensures exceptional speed and responsiveness for a wide array of tasks, from everyday productivity and web Browse to more demanding applications like photo and video editing, and even some light gaming.
The integrated 10-core GPU is the higher-tier graphics option available for the 13-inch M3 MacBook Air. It delivers significant advancements in graphics performance, supporting hardware-accelerated ray tracing and mesh shading, which translates to stunning visuals and faster rendering for creative projects and immersive experiences. Furthermore, the 16-core Neural Engine provides substantial power for on-device machine learning operations, accelerating AI features within macOS and supporting AI-driven applications with remarkable efficiency.

Apple has launched its new MacBook Air 15-inch model based on the M2 chip in India at its WWDC 2023event. It has a large 15.3-inch Liquid Retina display with 500 nits of brightness, and has the same fanless design, as the 13-inch model, but this has an all-new six-speaker sound system with Spatial Audio and up to 18 hours of battery life.
The thickness of the MacBook Air is just 11.5 mm and weighs just 1.4 kg.
